A change to tomato ketchup or barbeque sauce from any other subheading, provided that: 

- the net weight of non-originating sugar used in production does not exceed **40%** of the net weight of the product,

- the net weight of non-originating material of [heading 0407](/headings/0407), [heading 0408](/headings/0408) or [heading 0410](/headings/0410) used in production does not exceed **20%** of the net weight of the product, and 

- the net weight of non-originating sugar and non-originating material of [heading 0407](/headings/0407), [heading 0408](/headings/0408) or [heading 0410](/headings/0410) used in production does not exceed **50%** of the net weight of the product.

A change to any other product of [subheading 210320](/subheadings/2103200000-80) from any other subheading, provided that: 

- the net weight of non-originating sugar used in production does not exceed **20%** of the net weight of the product, *and*

- the net weight of non-originating material of [heading 0407](/headings/0407) to [heading 0410](/headings/0410) used in production does not exceed **20%** of the net weight of the product.
